lessonTitle: 6. Number of solutions of a linear system
lessonTitleEnglish: Number of solutions of a linear system
unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Systems of linear equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 8 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The system a₁x + b₁y = c₁, a₂x + b₂y = c₂ has one solution when a₁ : a₂ ≠ b₁ : b₂.
stages.headlineEnglish: The system a₁x + b₁y = c₁, a₂x + b₂y = c₂ has one solution when a₁ : a₂ ≠ b₁ : b₂.

stages.headline: If a₁ : a₂ = b₁ : b₂ ≠ c₁ : c₂ there is no solution; if all three ratios are equal there are infinitely many.
stages.headlineEnglish: If a₁ : a₂ = b₁ : b₂ ≠ c₁ : c₂ there is no solution; if all three ratios are equal there are infinitely many.

stages.headline: A system without solutions is inconsistent; in the language of lines, parallel lines don't meet.
stages.headlineEnglish: A system without solutions is inconsistent; in the language of lines, parallel lines don't meet.
